title: Late Payment Fee Posting Rules: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program
content:
## Rule

The Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program prices the late payment fee of the enrollment's most recently posted tuition charge, for a month that owes one under the late-fee rule below. A month's late payment fee is posted before the next month's tuition charge posts. An enrollment with no posted tuition charge has no late payment fee to price.

When the amounts applied by the due day leave any part of that month's tuition unpaid, one late payment fee still posts the late-fee offset days after the due day. For a billing month of an enrollment of the 2026-27 school year, and only for such a month, that fee is priced by the board-approved 2026-27 late payment fee schedule. For a billing month of any other school year it is still the program's late payment fee. A month whose tuition posted after its due day still becomes late only at the next month's due day.

Whether a month owes a late payment fee is decided as the program's billing rules decide it: payments, remittances and credits are applied to the enrollment's oldest open charge first, and a returned payment never counts as paid. The schedule sets only the amount of the fee.

**Effect of posting.** One late payment fee entry is booked on the enrollment's billing history for that billing month, dated the day it is posted. The enrollment's balance due goes up by the fee, and the fee then shows in the billing history next to that month.

## Invocation: `post_late_payment_fee_d20db65b`

This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `post_late_payment_fee_d20db65b` and then calls it. One call books one late payment fee entry.

- `care_enrollment_id`: the Extended Day enrollment reference number whose month was paid late, as returned by the Extended Day enrollment lookup. Identifier.
- `billing_month`: the billing month the fee is for, written YYYY-MM, exactly as shown on that month's tuition charge in the enrollment's billing history lookup.
- `fee_amount`: the fee in US dollars. It must be a positive amount with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent, half a cent rounding up. Zero or negative amounts are not accepted.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new fee entry's reference number (text beginning `clf_`), the enrollment reference number, the billing month (YYYY-MM), the fee in dollars with two decimals and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). Its presence means the fee is booked.

**Errors.** A sentence beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked. This happens when the fee amount is not a positive amount with at most two decimal places, when the billing month is not written YYYY-MM, or when no Extended Day enrollment has the reference number given.

## Questions answered

**Does a month whose tuition was paid in full by the due day owe a fee?** No. A fee posts only when the amounts applied by the due day leave part of that month's tuition unpaid.

**A payment was made before the due day but later returned by the bank. Does it count?** No. A returned payment never counts as paid.

**A month's tuition posted after its due day. When does it become late?** Only at the next month's due day.
